current_path: Single published piece → lead magnet opt-in → email sequence → dead end. No commenting strategy, no DM follow-up system, no clear decision-stage content. Limited touchpoints before asking for commitment.

step_1.action: Publish content that invites engagement and commentary
step_1.content_type: LinkedIn posts, blog snippets, industry takes (use all 4 approved pieces here)
step_1.conversion_trigger: High-quality comment = signal of interest. Automated tagging for follow-up.

step_2.action: DM commenters with personalized value message
step_2.content_type: Direct message with specific reference to their comment + lead magnet offer
step_2.conversion_trigger: Lead magnet download = permission to nurture. Email added to sequence.

step_3.action: Nurture with educational sequence + social proof
step_3.content_type: Email sequence (existing) + case study, comparison content, webinar invite
step_3.conversion_trigger: Email engagement metrics (open rate >40%, click rate >15%) = move to step 4. OR webinar registration.

step_4.content_type: Personalized email + phone/calendar link. Case study or ROI calculator if relevant.
step_4.conversion_trigger: Calendar booking or sales rep phone call scheduled.

cta_matrix.primary_cta: comment-based (ask specific question to spark discussion)
cta_matrix.conversion_rate: expected 3-8% comment rate, 15-25% of commenters convert to DM

cta_matrix.primary_cta: Download lead magnet mid-content (gate after value demo)
cta_matrix.conversion_rate: expected 8-15% lead magnet, 2-5% direct call booking

missing_assets: DM response template library (3-5 versions for different commenter personas)
Case study or social proof content (testimonial video, ROI breakdown, before/after)
Webinar or product demo video (consideration-stage content)
Lead magnet asset checklist: ensure it's gated, downloadable, and tied to first email
Comparison/alternative content (competitors or old approach vs. new)
Calendar booking integration (Calendly/HubSpot link in emails)
Retargeting email sequence (for lead magnet downloaders who don't engage)
Sales enablement doc (talking points for post-call follow-up)
quick_fixes: Add comment CTAs to all 4 approved pieces NOW. Change from 'like' to 'tell me in the comments' format.
Build simple DM automation: If LinkedIn comment detected → schedule DM with lead magnet link within 2 hours.
Insert lead magnet CTA in email #1 (not email #3). Move decision earlier.
Create 'DM offer' slide for each piece: specific value prop + single link to lead magnet.
Tag all commenters manually (if no automation) and prioritize warm outreach.
Add UTM tracking to each CTA so you know which content produces highest-intent leads.
Replace vague CTAs ('Learn more') with specific ones ('Get the [resource] now' or 'See how [company] increased X by Y%').
Set up email sequence trigger: lead magnet download → email within 30 min (urgency + relevance).

dm_playbook.trigger: Within 2 hours of comment on your post. Prioritize: detailed comments > questions > simple likes.
dm_playbook.opener: Hi [Name], thanks for [specific comment detail]. That's exactly what we see with our clients. I put together [lead magnet name] that covers X, Y, Z—might be useful. [link] 👇
dm_playbook.follow_up: If no response in 5 days: 'Hi [Name], checking if you grabbed the [resource]? Happy to answer any Qs—just reply here or grab 15 min: [calendar link]'
dm_playbook.close: If positive engagement: 'Looks like [resource] was helpful. Would it make sense to do a quick call to map out [specific use case for them]? I can do [2 dates/times].'

variables.reference_their_comment: Shows you read it, not automated
